oracle.scope: the 34 non-generate /api/sd routes; the 19 */generate* routes are out of scope

urlPlaceholders.<mock>: the local mock peer authority used for the run; the Go replay test substitutes its own mock authority

conventions.requestHeaderOrder: header lines are recorded in wire order; `connection` is the only shape-classified header

notRecorded: the mock peer authority itself (normalised to <mock>) because it is an ephemeral port

every value of a field classified shape: such a field is recorded as NULL rather than as the value this host produced, because the zero-diff gate compares the fixture BYTES and a rendered error page embeds an absolute path and stack frames (see ping.malformedJson, whose contentType, contentLength, etag and body are all null)
